geometry.classification: Virtual uniform 1D 100 cm3 chain with sealed left end and a zero-storage gas/thermal/radiative right surface. Immobile pure solids; no measured brick geometry.

transport.classification: Explicit virtual continuum coefficients. Face conductance/mobility scales as area over center distance; neither inferred nor measured brick transport.

initial_mapping: Divide the original total inventory and volume equally. Same external program; half-cell transport is a declared new surface constitutive increment, so one cell is not expected to equal the direct-contact capsule.
external_contact_definition: The exterior film connects bath to zero-storage surface, interior conductance connects surface to terminal center over dx/2, and blackbody heat reaches the surface. Body receives inner flux only; external energy ledger records outer flux plus radiation. Both faces and all residuals are recorded explicitly.

numerics.inventory_absolute_tolerance_basis: Whole-capsule original absolute tolerance divided by actual cell count; ledger and temperature tolerances unchanged.

scope: First qualify source and local rate assembly at 1/2/4 cells, then the full one-cell base/refined program. Preserve direct-terminal trajectories independently. No measured material, finite kinetics, shrinkage or full-cycle qualification.
